$description: Design tokens for ICC-IMS. DTCG format. Three tiers: primitive -> semantic -> component. Values measured from the ICC-IMS Figma file (Homepage_08/20/2026, node 10479:1744) on 2026-09-09. This file is the source of truth for color, spacing, type, radius, and elevation. The AI must pull from here and never invent values. See design-system/README.md for how these map to the Figma variable architecture.

navy-700.$description: Primary brand navy. Headings on light, nav links, band backgrounds. Measured from Figma.

navy-900.$description: Deep navy. Card overlay panels (used at 92% opacity), darkest surfaces. Measured from Figma.

red-500.$description: ICC-IMS red. CTAs, eyebrows, section labels. Measured from Figma.

teal-300.$description: Teal accent. Links on dark surfaces, dividers on navy (at 24% opacity). Measured from Figma.

100.$description: Hairlines, borders, dividers on light. Measured from Figma.

600.$description: Body text on light. Measured from Figma.

success.$description: Kit default; no success color observed in the file yet. (inferred, confirm?)

danger.$description: Kit default; brand red #EF4238 is reserved for CTAs, not errors. (inferred, confirm?)

pill.$description: Not observed on the homepage; keep for chips if needed.

shadow.$description: The homepage leans on flat panels and hairlines, not elevation. Keep shadows minimal.

display.$description: SemiBold (600) for all headings. From Figma Desktop/* text variables.

body.$description: Regular 400 body, SemiBold 600 for buttons, eyebrows, H4/H5. From Figma variables.

size.$description: From the Figma Desktop/* type variables (px).

base.$description: Paragraph 01 lh 25; H4 lh 26; Eyebrow (ls 3, uppercase)

semantic.$description: Purpose-tied aliases. This is what components and the AI reference by name. WCAG ratios computed, not eyeballed.

$extensions.wcag: white text on #EF4238 = 3.81:1. Passes AA large-text only; 14px/600 button text is BELOW the large-text threshold. Known risk, flagged at intake.
on #FFFFFF = 3.81:1. AA large-text only; 16px/600 uppercase is borderline. Known risk, flagged at intake.

$extensions.note: Secondary text on navy uses white at 80-85% opacity in the file.

bg-band.$description: Full-bleed navy bands: trust bar, next steps, procurement, footer.

bg-panel-dark.$description: Card caption panels, at 92% opacity over imagery.

component.$description: Component-level tokens, aliasing semantic tokens. Measured from the homepage.

padding-x.$description: Measured: px-20 py-10 on both CTA variants.
Measured: px-64 py-24, bottom hairline border-default.
